projects.title: Self-Learning Robot with Reinforcement Learning
projects.description:
-Goal is to train the HROS-5 humanoid robot to learn walking using reinforcement learning algorithm.
- Implemented the ROS environment with Gazebo (Environment for Reinforcement Learning).
- Studied the human walking cycle and implemented the basic walking motion for HROS-5 in MoveIt.
- Divided the walking cycle into 5 different parts to be Goals for Reinforcement Learning and
Combinations of servos to be Agents in Reinforcement Learning.

projects.title: Implementation of Cache simulator
projects.description:
- Designed and Simulated a L1 cache controller with 1-bit LRU replacement policy.
- The simulator will provide statistics about cache hit ratio, read traffic, write traffic etc.
